notes: Excerpt of the 2026 Annual Budget: printed pages 75-118 of 424 (39 scanned pages). Scan p-01 is a second scan of printed page 36 (end of Part 1, already transcribed there) and was not transcribed again; scan p-22 is a blank page. Printed pages 77, 85, 90, 93, 102, 105 and 108 are not in this scan (they fall between offices). Printed pages 112-113 (Office of the City Library) were scanned last (p-38, p-39), after page 118.

Covers 18 offices, each its own table in scan order: City Vice Mayor's Office, Internal Audit Office, Sangguniang Panlungsod, Secretary to the SP, City Administrator, City HRMDO, City Planning and Development, City Civil Registrar, City General Services (plus its Special Purpose Appropriation for the Bids and Awards Committee), City Budget Officer, City Accountant, City Treasurer, City Assessor, City Auditor, City Attorney, City Prosecutor, Parole and Probation, City Library.

Columns: 2024 Past Year Actual, 2025 First Semester Actual, 2025 Second Semester Estimates, 2025 Total, 2026 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos. A printed '-' is 0; a blank cell is null (e.g. capital outlay with no 2026 proposal is null or 0 as printed).

Account codes are transcribed as printed; codes printed with a leading dash (e.g. '-5-01-02-010') carry the office prefix of the first code in the block (e.g. 1016). Some codes are printed with a space after the dash ('- 5-02-05-020') and are kept as printed.

Office of the City General Services: the Bids and Awards Committee Special Purpose Appropriation (printed page 99) is its own table 'spa-bids-and-awards-committee' (PS 2,273,000.00 in 2025 only; 2026 proposed MOOE 350,000.00). The office's GRAND TOTAL including the BAC (2026 proposed 435,433,299.00) is kept in table 'office-of-the-city-general-services-grand-total' and excluded from summary.offices to avoid double counting. The GSO printed pages 97-98 carry no signature block; the BAC page is signed by Ronaldo D. Malacora, OIC GSO.
Office of the City General Services, MOOE: both 'Telephone Expenses' and 'Telephone Expenses-Mobile' are printed with account code -5-02-05-020; transcribed as printed.
Office of the City Treasurer, MOOE: 'Five (5) Units DOT Matrix Printer - Nine (9) Pins' is printed as an MOOE line (code -5-02-03-010, 2024 actual 84,750.00 only); transcribed as printed.

Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod, MOOE (printed page 84): the amounts are printed visibly offset (one to two lines lower) from their object labels; they were assigned to objects in account-code order, which reproduces every printed subtotal exactly.
Office of the City Administrator: the Capital Outlay sub-total line (72,500.00) is printed without a 'SUB-TOTAL' label.

Offices without a printed Capital Outlay section (City Assessor, Parole and Probation, City Library) or without Personal Services (City Auditor, Parole and Probation) have null for that class in summary.offices. Parole and Probation prints only a MOOE list and a TOTAL, so its MOOE in summary.offices is the printed TOTAL.
Every printed subtotal and total in this excerpt equals the sum of its items in every column (checked arithmetically); no illegible cells.
